dogecoin.text:
Is #DOGE here to stay? Will it go to the moon and trade at $1 per coin? Perhaps even higher? Only time will tell. 

What do you think of #dogecoin? Let us know below 👇
In 2013, #Dogecoin jumped nearly 300% in value in 72 hours, rising from US$0.00026 to $0.00095. Three days later, Dogecoin experienced its first major crash by dropping by 80%.
Invented in December 2013, #Dogecoin or #DOGE was created by software engineers Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer to create a payment system that was instant, fun and had no transaction fees.
